Peter
Peter did not have any brothers or sisters. He was an only child. Peter lived in a big
city near a river but he liked to go to the park in the afternoon after school when the
weather was nice. He walked in the park and looked at other boys who played
football there.
When it rained, his mum took him to the library where Peter chose a book to read. He
liked reading very much. He enjoyed books about pirates and space explorers but he
did not like fairy tales.
When Peter was ten years old his father said that he did not have a job any more.
Peter’s parents decided to sell their house in the city and move to a small village.
Peter was both happy and sad. He enjoyed living in a big city but he was happy
because he hoped to have a lot of adventures in the countryside.
A. How many children were there in Peter’s family?
